nix_spike.method: NIX_SHOW_STATS=1 nix eval --impure --json --expr: builtins.getFlake on the isolated pinned checkout, map drvPath over 3 policy checks, 10 artifact-target nixPackage packages, then all 13. Three sequential repetitions; pinned artifacts, no PR artifact overrides. Exact combined drvPath list equalled concatenated separate lists in every repetition.
nix_spike.command_recipe:
import json,os,pathlib,subprocess
p=pathlib.Path('OUTPUT_DIRECTORY');p.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
checks=['claude-code-permissions','codex-execpolicy-evaluation','gemini-cli-integration']
spec=json.load(open('devinfra/ci/artifact_targets.json'));packages=[k for k,v in spec['releases'].items() if v.get('nixPackage')]
attrs=[f'f.checks.x86_64-linux."{x}"' for x in checks];pkgs=[f'f.packages.x86_64-linux."{x}"' for x in packages]
for repeat in range(3):
 results={}
 for name,values in [('policies',attrs),('packages',pkgs),('combined',attrs+pkgs)]:
  expr='let f = builtins.getFlake "'+str(pathlib.Path.cwd())+'"; in map (x: x.drvPath) [ '+' '.join(values)+' ]'
  env=dict(os.environ,NIX_SHOW_STATS='1')
  proc=subprocess.run(['nix','eval','--impure','--json','--expr',expr],capture_output=True,text=True,env=env)
  (p/f'{repeat}-{name}.stdout').write_text(proc.stdout);(p/f'{repeat}-{name}.stderr').write_text(proc.stderr)
  proc.check_returncode();results[name]=json.loads(proc.stdout)
  print(repeat,name,'evaluated',len(results[name]),flush=True)
 assert results['combined']==results['policies']+results['packages']
 print('same derivations',repeat,flush=True)

Start is earliest matching-head PR workflow creation, not push timestamp. Required latest-check completion is a CI proxy, not observed auto-merge readiness.
53 devel heads selected from 54 evenly spaced latest-head samples across three UTC days; one history PR excluded. Nonrandom day-balanced sample; counts are not workflow run counts.
No historical webhook/inbox/harness receipt timestamps; first API/log availability unmeasured for production heads. Logs successfully read retrospectively only.
PR class paths classify work; no verified per-path trigger attribution or matched pre-cdk8s experiment.
Generated summary longest_jobs/longest_queues include older active-discovery runs; use the filtered workflow tables and recent_bazel for window claims.
Initial four-day CI workflow query hit 1000-result cap and was excluded. Supersession analysis used a separate uncapped 252-run pull_request query for Oct 6 through Oct 7 08:32 UTC.
